What shortwave stations can I hear in Canada?

Tonight's best bets in Canada include Radio Habana Cuba on 9710 kHz, China Radio International on 9580 kHz, America250 DueDiligence on 9395 kHz. Stations beamed at North America are the easiest catches; the tables on this page are rebuilt daily from the published schedule.

What time is best for shortwave listening in Canada?

Evening and night are best for distant stations. In eastern Canada the evening bands are mostly 49, 41 and 31 metres (6, 7 and 9.5 MHz). Out west, subtract three hours from the Eastern times shown here.

Are there English shortwave broadcasts to Canada?

Yes. 26 stations broadcast in English toward North America this season, including America250 DueDiligence, Radio Habana Cuba, Polish Radio, Radio Slovakia International.

How do I convert shortwave UTC times to Canada time?

Shortwave schedules use UTC. Canada is currently on Eastern (EDT), which is UTC-4. This page already shows times in local time.

Can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Yes. Free WebSDR and KiwiSDR receivers let you tune real shortwave receivers in your browser. See the Listen Online page.
